bullets: On Sunday, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the Ukrainian military had hit the Slavyansk and Yaroslavl oil refineries in Russia overnight with long-range drones, about 300km and 700km (190 and 435 miles) from the front line, respectively.

Recommended Stories list of 3 items end of list “It is clear why this proposal is being made because our counterstrikes deep into Ukrainian territory are much stronger, have greater impact and are, frankly, more destructive,” Putin said.
In an interview with Russia’s state television service on Sunday, Putin said Ukraine had proposed a mutual halt to long-range attacks as a step towards peace.
Putin acknowledged that Russia has had to increase its air defence capacity to counter intensified Ukrainian drone attacks that have targeted Russia’s oil industry in recent months.
Ukraine’s attacks on Russian refineries are the latest in a campaign against Russian energy sites that has gathered pace in recent weeks.
related.excerpt: Russian President Vladimir Putin says Moscow will continue its more than four-year-long war on Ukraine, rejecting Kyiv’s proposals to limit the use of long-range missiles and stop hostilities. In an interview with Russia’s state television service on Sunday, Putin said Ukraine had proposed a mutual halt to long-range attacks as a step towards peace. But the Russian president suggested this proposal was made because Kyiv’s forces were under pressure along the 1,250km (775-mile) front line. Recommended Stories list of 3 items end of list “It is clear why this proposal is being made because our counterstrikes deep into Ukrainian territory are much stronger, have greater impact and are, frankly, more destructive,” Putin said. “Given their catastrophic shortage of personnel, the Ukrainian armed forces apparently believe this could be their salvation.
